name: ArchiveBridge
description: Save the current page as MHTML or Safari WebArchive, and open local .webarchive files that Chrome cannot display itself.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src blob: data:; font-src blob: data:; media-src blob: data:; frame-src blob:; object-src 'none'; connect-src file:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
